description: An immersive, dark 'in-space' aesthetic dashboard that visualizes EVE Online NPSI fleet roam reports. The experience should feel like a tactical command center on a spaceship, overlaying dense data panels on top of a vast, interactive 2D starfield map.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tighter uppercase text-white drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,240,255,0.5)]
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight uppercase text-gray-100

rules: Use 'Rajdhani' for all major headings and UI module titles to give a sharp, sci-fi HUD feel.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for tabular data, stats, ISK values, and killmail details for alignment and tactical feel.
Numbers and ISK values MUST use tabular lining features (e.g., `tabular-nums`) to align digits perfectly.
Never use Inter or generic sans-serif fonts for headings.
No generic full-screen color gradients. Use deep void black and deep space blue.
Use Neon Cyan for primary interactions and active states.
Use Minmatar Rust/Red or Amarr Gold/Amber for high-threat elements, kills, or top damage.
Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG AA standards, especially over glassmorphism.
Use 'Tinted Grey' rule: Greys should have a slight blue/indigo tint to fit the deep space theme.

surfaces.glass_panels: Crystal Glass style. Backdrop blur is mandatory (`backdrop-blur-xl` or `backdrop-blur-2xl`). Background `bg-black/60` to `bg-[#0B101E]/70`. Must have a delicate inner stroke (`border border-white/10`) to separate from the star map.
surfaces.hud_elements: Add sharp, technical grid borders (`border-b border-r border-white/10`) for data tables and stat blocks to mimic a ship's tactical interface.

effects.glow: Use subtle `drop-shadow` for glowing neon text and active UI elements (e.g., `drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,240,255,0.5)]`).
effects.scanlines: Optional: Add a very faint, repeating linear gradient overlay on empty UI module areas to give a retro-futuristic terminal feel.
effects.hotspots: For map hotspots (kills), use concentric animated rings or radial gradients simulating glowing stellar phenomena.

layouts.page_structure: Full-screen immersive application layout (100vw, 100vh). No standard scrolling website structure.

layers.layer_0_background: Full-screen D3.js + HTML5 Canvas rendering the New Eden star map and neon route lines.
layers.layer_1_ui: Floating 'Bento' Grid of glass panels on top of the map. Pointer events none on the wrapper, auto on the panels.
layers.left_sidebar: w-80 or w-96 flex col layout for the Fleet Summary, Total Kills, and Region Breakdown.
layers.right_sidebar: w-80 or w-96 flex col layout containing the Scrollable Killmail Feed and Member Roster.
layers.top_bar: Minimalist header with app branding and report search/input field.

layouts.spacing: Dense internal padding for data panels (`p-4` or `p-6`) to utilize every pixel efficiently, with `gap-4` between bento widgets.

components.cards: Override Shadcn Card. Remove solid backgrounds and shadows. Replace with `bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10`. Square or max `rounded-md` corners (sharp technical feel).
components.inputs: Shadcn Input but styled as terminal prompts: `bg-black/40 border border-white/20 text-cyan-400 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-cyan-400 rounded-none`.
components.buttons: Technical, flat buttons. `bg-cyan-500/10 text-cyan-400 border border-cyan-400/50 hover:bg-cyan-500/20 hover:shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(0,240,255,0.4)] transition-all uppercase tracking-wider text-xs font-bold`.
components.scrollbars: Custom styled scrollbars are MANDATORY. 4px width, `bg-white/5` track, `bg-white/20` thumb. No standard browser gutters.
components.portraits: Pilot/Victim portraits should have sharp corners or cut-out hexagonal/octagonal masks, with a 1px solid border matching their faction or status.

interactive_map_guidelines.technology: D3.js + HTML5 Canvas is MANDATORY for the star map to handle ~8000 nodes without DOM lag.
implementation_pattern: Use D3 for scaling and coordinate mapping (projecting CCP SDE X/Z coordinates to screen space).
Use Canvas `ctx.arc()` to draw the 8000 background systems as faint, tiny dots (`rgba(255,255,255,0.3)`, radius 1-1.5).
Draw jump route lines as faint connecting strokes.
Overlay 'Content Hotspots' (systems with kills) as larger, glowing nodes on the Canvas.
Size the hotspot nodes by kill count or ISK destroyed.
Color the hotspots using a heat scale (e.g., Cyan -> Yellow -> Orange -> Red) based on intensity.
Implement zoom/pan using `d3.zoom()` attached to the Canvas.
Implement a spatial index (e.g., `d3.quadtree`) or hidden hit-canvas to detect hover/click events efficiently on the 8000 nodes.

background_nebula_texture.description: Deep space nebula texture. Use as a highly transparent background image (`opacity-10` to `opacity-20`) beneath the Canvas star map or as a texture overlay to give depth to the void.

hud_reference.description: Sci-fi spaceship dashboard UI reference for grid styling and neon accent inspiration.

general_ui_ux_guidelines.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="search-report-input"`, `data-testid="killmail-item-12345"`).
general_ui_ux_guidelines.links: Clicking a system on the map or a pilot portrait in the feed MUST open an external link to zKillboard or npsi.rocks character pages (`target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"`).
general_ui_ux_guidelines.interactions: Hovering over a hotspot on the map should highlight the node, display a tooltip with system stats (Kills, ISK), and dynamically filter or highlight the side panel feed.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.transitions: Use quick, snappy transitions (`duration-150 ease-out`) for UI elements. Avoid slow, floaty animations in a tactical dashboard.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.transparency_rule: NEVER use a completely transparent background on interactive elements (dropdowns, inputs) placed over the star map. Always use `bg-black/80` or similar to ensure text readability.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use `d3` and `@types/d3` for the star map rendering math and zoom behaviors.
Do not use SVG circles for the 8000 systems; it will lag. Use a single `<canvas>` element.
Fetch and parse the EVE SDE map data and npsi.rocks fleet data, merging the kill locations with the SDE coordinates.
Layout the app as a full-viewport absolute positioned UI, with floating panels positioned over the canvas map.
Implement Shadcn UI for dropdowns and inputs, but severely override the styling to match the Glass/Neon theme.
Ensure `Rajdhani` and `JetBrains Mono` are imported via Google Fonts or standard imports.
